name: Shojo Dakkan ~Ojou-sama o Lady ni~
original_name: 処女奪館～お嬢様をレディに～
source:
Three maidens live a quiet mountain area. Main character is a butler who raised them. As he sees them grow up and doing obscene things with their bodies, his manhood wakes up and eventually bursts with the news of house master's approaching death.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
三个少女住在一个安静的山区。主角是抚养他们长大的管家。当他看到他们长大并用自己的身体做猥亵的事情时，他的男子气概苏醒了，并最终因房主即将去世的消息而爆发。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
